description: 两原专家页实际收件后按原语句人工固定事实与层级，不把整体PMI共同解释叫生产/股票因果，严格首件未知保持，0模型。
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import json,hashlib,re,unicodedata
import pandas as pd
ROOT=Path.cwd();R='reports/research/510300_equal_production_official_interpretation_source_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def readj(p):return json.loads((ROOT/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def save(name,obj):
 p=OUT/name;assert not p.exists(),'已有文件不覆盖：'+name
 p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
def norm(s):return re.sub(r'\s+','',unicodedata.normalize('NFKC',s))
proto=readj(R+'/protocol.json');receipts=readj(R+'/原官方两月收件.json');assert len(receipts)==2
facts=[];clocks=[]
for z in receipts:
 assert z['status']=='RAW_ORIGINAL_RECEIVED' and z['expected_title_matches']
 assert sha(ROOT/z['raw_path'])==z['raw_sha256']
 soup=BeautifulSoup((ROOT/z['raw_path']).read_bytes(),'html.parser')
 for x in soup.select('script,style'):x.decompose()
 text=norm(soup.get_text(' ',strip=True))
 isaug=z['stat_month']=='2024-08'
 target='受近期高温多雨、部分行业生产淡季等因素影响,8月份制造业PMI降至49.1%,景气水平有所回落。' if isaug else '4月份,受前期制造业较快增长形成较高基数叠加外部环境急剧变化等因素影响,制造业PMI为49.0%,回落至临界点以下。'
 price='受需求不足以及原油、煤炭、铁矿石等大宗商品价格波动等因素影响' if isaug else '受市场需求不足和近期部分大宗商品价格持续下行等因素影响'
 assert target in text and price in text
 factors=['近期高温多雨','部分行业生产淡季'] if isaug else ['前期较快增长形成较高基数','外部环境急剧变化']
 metadata=[x['content'] for x in z['html_metadata'] if x['name']=='PubDate'];assert len(metadata)==1
 stamp=pd.Timestamp(metadata[0]).tz_localize('Asia/Shanghai')
 relevant_decisions=['2024-09-19T16:00:00+08:00','2024-09-20T16:00:00+08:00','2024-09-23T16:00:00+08:00','2024-09-24T16:00:00+08:00','2024-09-25T16:00:00+08:00'] if isaug else ['2025-04-30T16:00:00+08:00','2025-05-13T16:00:00+08:00','2025-05-21T16:00:00+08:00','2025-05-29T16:00:00+08:00']
 positions=[m.start() for m in re.finditer(re.escape(target),text)]
 pricepositions=[m.start() for m in re.finditer(re.escape(price),text)]
 facts.append({'stat_month':z['stat_month'],'production_index':49.8,'source_url':z['url'],'raw_path':z['raw_path'],'raw_sha256':z['raw_sha256'],'original_official_joint_cause_excerpt':target,'explicit_joint_factors':factors,'source_target_metric':'整体制造业PMI回落，不把共同解释叫生产单项效应','cause_grade':'OFFICIAL_EXPLICIT_JOINT_PMI_CONTEXT_NOT_SINGLE_FACTOR_CAUSAL_EFFECT','all_excerpt_positions':positions,'shared_price_cause_excerpt':price,'all_price_excerpt_positions':pricepositions,'shared_price_factors':['需求不足','大宗商品价格因素'],'joint_context_not_exclusive_labels':True,'factor_weights_or_effect_sizes':'UNKNOWN','specific_production_single_factor_effect':'NOT_IDENTIFIED','CSI300_return_causal_effect':'NOT_IDENTIFIED','complete_market_consensus_or_surprise':'UNKNOWN','tariff_only_production_cause':'NOT_IDENTIFIED' if not isaug else 'NOT_APPLICABLE','numeric_training_field_admitted':False,'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False})
 for decision in relevant_decisions:
  d=pd.Timestamp(decision);assert stamp<d
  clocks.append({'stat_month':z['stat_month'],'published_display_meta':stamp.isoformat(),'visible_page_minute':z['published_at_candidates'][0] if z['published_at_candidates'] else 'UNKNOWN_VISIBLE_PAGE_DAY_ONLY','visible_creation_date':z['declared_creation_date_candidates'][0] if z['declared_creation_date_candidates'] else None,'publication_basis':'HTML_META_PUBDATE_MINUTE_VISIBLE_CREATION_DATE_DAY' if isaug else 'VISIBLE_MINUTE_AND_HTML_META_PUBDATE_AGREE','original_decision':decision,'before_original_decision_under_display_or_metadata_proxy':True,'display_proxy_hours_before_decision':(d-stamp).total_seconds()/3600,'strict_original_first_receipt_intraday':'UNKNOWN','received_now':z['received_at'],'current_archive_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'new_decision_or_trade_enabled':False})
save('全部两月官方共同原因_明确与未识别分开.json',facts)
pd.DataFrame(clocks).to_csv(OUT/'两原原因显示钟与原决定_严格首件未知.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
result={'study_id':proto['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E54','completed_at':now(),'status':'COMPLETED_TWO_ORIGINAL_OFFICIAL_JOINT_CAUSES_DIFFERENT_DISPLAY_CLOCK_PREDECISION_FIRST_VINTAGE_UNAUTHENTICATED','fixed_stat_months':['2024-08','2025-04'],'source_received_count':2,'public_queries':2,'raw_original_GETs':2,'http_200_objects':2,'raw_bytes':sum(z['response_bytes'] for z in receipts),'retry_count':0,'explicit_official_joint_contexts':{z['stat_month']:z['explicit_joint_factors'] for z in facts},'common_price_contexts':['需求不足','大宗商品价格因素'],'joint_contexts_not_exclusive_or_complete':True,'cause_numeric_weights':'UNKNOWN','direct_single_production_or_stock_effect':'NOT_IDENTIFIED','display_or_metadata_clock_predecision':True,'original_first_receipt_or_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'full_original_training_source_gate_for_qualitative_causes':'NOT_ESTABLISHED_ONLY_TWO_POST_SELECTED_MONTHS','new_model_fields_admitted':0,'new_model_fits':0,'new_labels':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,'authenticated_requests':0,'independent_validation':False,'original_E51_rejection_preserved':True,'E53_data_release_specific_cause_unknown_preserved':True,'E38_old_three_month_route_not_reopened':True,'goal_achieved':False,'full_goal_preserved':True,'net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','live_process':False,'classification':'PROGRESS_E54_ACTUAL_TWO_ORIGINAL_OFFICIAL_CAUSE_CONTEXTS_AND_TIMING','root_consecutive_blocked_goal_turns':0,'report':R+'/相同49点8_原官方共同原因与可知性.md'}
save('result.json',result)
report=['# E54：相同49.8的原官方共同原因与可知性','',
'两原统计月生产指数同49.8，但原官方专家解读明确说明整体制造业PMI的共同影响因素不同；共同解释非单项生产因果效应。','',
'| 原统计月 | 原解读明确共同因素 | 原公布/显示依据 | 对原决定的可知性界 |','|---|---|---|---|',
'| 2024-08 | 近期高温多雨、部分行业生产淡季；原稿另称高耗能行业偏弱是PMI回落主要原因之一 | 信息公开页成文8/31；HTML PubDate 8/31 09:30 | 显示元数据代理早于9/19—25决定；严格首件/首版仍未知 |',
'| 2025-04 | 前期较快增长形成较高基数，叠加外部环境急剧变化 | 原页显示4/30 09:30与HTML PubDate相同 | 显示代理早于4/30 16:00及5月三个决定；严格首件/首版仍未知 |','',
'两稿还共同提到需求不足与大宗商品价格因素对价格指数的影响。不是“纯天气”和“纯关税”互斥两类；外部环境解读提贸易不确定性，但不能把生产下降2.8点全归关税，也没有数值因果权重或完整市场预期。','',
'现有原四生产高分把2025-04状态映入包含2024-09重叠上涨的成熟叶，E52已说明贡献集中。本轮新增原明确共同原因桥支持不能只凭同49.8判断经济情景相同；没有识别股票方向、尚未反映信息或因果收益。E51固定拒绝保持，不删标签/重训/改期或把两后选月份编码为原因标签。','',
'原数据页E53具体原因UNKNOWN与专家解读共同因素明确是不同来源/层级，两个原结论同时保持；E38旧三月采购路线不扩。两原GET200共'+str(result['raw_bytes'])+'字节，2固定官方查询/2GET预算结束、0重试/凭据/新标签/拟合/账户/既有源码改动。全训练原因字段并未建立，夏普NOT_COMPUTED、目标未达。','',
'[固定源协议](protocol.json)、[原两月收件](原官方两月收件.json)、[明确与未识别分开](全部两月官方共同原因_明确与未识别分开.json)、[原决定钟](两原原因显示钟与原决定_严格首件未知.csv)、[结果](result.json)。']
(OUT/'相同49点8_原官方共同原因与可知性.md').write_text('\n'.join(report)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
for x in proto['parents']:assert sha(ROOT/x['path'])==x['sha256']
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False))
